Dear Sir,
With reference to our earlier letter dated May 17, 2022, this is to inform you that pursuant
to requirement of the Listed Companies (Buy-Back of Shares) Regulation, 2019, Maple
Leaf Cement Factory Limited (the “Company") has published a Public Announcement
today i.e. May 19, 2022 in daily newspapers namely, The Business Recorder and Nawa-
e-Waqt,towardsbuy-backof sharesby theCompanyforinformation of valued
shareholders.
In this connection, we are pleased to enclose herewith a certified true copy of the Public
Announcement published in the above said newspapers foryour record and reference.
Yours faithfully,
For Maple/Leaf Cement Factory Ltd
